newer_changes_search: Web search (socialjustice.gov.in, PIB, NSP, press) for 2025-2026 changes to PM-YASASVI post-matric: no revised guidelines, no change to the Rs 2.5 lakh income limit or the course-group amounts found; only aggregator pages for 2026. No Cabinet approval for the 2026-31 cycle found; schemes of the 15th FC period were extended on the same terms to 30 Sep 2026 or approval, whichever earlier. The scheme is still taking 2026-27 applications via state portals/NSP. The expired guideline period (2021-22 to 2025-26) is minor because the content says so and points users to the portal.

findings.note: The clause (§5(i)) opens the scholarship to OBCs, EBCs and DNTs; the guidelines define EBC and DNT as students 'who are not covered under SC, ST or OBC' (line 92/121). The rule is social_category == 'obc' with confidence 'confirmed', so an EBC or DNT student (who would answer 'general' or 'ews') gets a firm NOT_ELIGIBLE, contradicting the clause and the rule's own text ('EBC and DNT students can also apply: check with the office').
findings.suggestion: Set confidence to 'uncertain' for this rule (a fail then shows 'check with the office'), keeping the logic {"==":[{"var":"social_category"},"obc"]}. Alternatively split it: a confirmed hard rule {"!":[{"in":[{"var":"social_category"},["sc","st"]]}]} is not appropriate either (SC/ST DNTs exist), so 'uncertain' is the simplest correct fix. Add a fixture: general-category student -> NEED_MORE_INFO with rules.category_obc = fail.

findings.note: <= 250000 matches 'does not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum'; fixtures test 250000 / 250001. Correct.

Group totals 20,000 / 13,000 / 8,000 / 5,000 match the §7.1 table (academic allowance + tuition fee). Group 4 has no tuition component (5000 + 0); 'pays a yearly academic allowance and tuition fee' is slightly broad. 'Your state may add more' matches §7.2 (state top-up of academic allowance).
findings.suggestion: Optional: 'For group 4 courses the amount is an academic allowance only.'

findings.note: Guideline period 2021-22 to 2025-26 has ended; no newer guideline found and the content already tells users to check the portal for this year's rules.
findings.suggestion: Re-check socialjustice.gov.in for 2026-31 guidelines; keep reverify_days at 90.
